cves.description: A flaw was found in the Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication CIBA implementation within the keycloak-services component of Keycloak. This component handles advanced authentication flows where a client initiates a login on behalf of a user. The issue occurs because Keycloak fails to verify that a client is authorized to use the CIBA flow, allowing public clients to bypass security requirements. An attacker could use this flaw to trick a user into approving a login request, eventually gaining full access to the users account without needing a client secret.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Red Hat Red Hat Build of Keycloak
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: A security flaw has been discovered in tsi-coop tsi-dpdp-cms 0.5.0/0.5.1/0.5.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component JSON Schema Validation. The manipulation of the argument _func results in information disclosure. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. Upgrading to version 0.5.3 is recommended to address this issue. You should upgrade the affected component. The vendor was contacted early, responded in a very professional manner and quickly released a fixed version of the affected product.
